description: This file defines the class 'SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase' which manages initialization, schema migration, and transaction handling for a SQLite database within the Chromium project. It includes method declarations for database operations, error handling, and task scheduling, serving as a base class for database backends.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A thread-safe reference-counted class that manages the lifecycle, schema, and transaction operations of a SQLite database, including schema migration, error handling, and task scheduling.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Posts a task to flush pending database operations in the background; runs callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Commits pending operations and closes the database, to be called before destruction.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before committing transactions.

methods.name: InitializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database on a background thread, including schema migration and setup.

methods.name: RecordOpenDBProblem
methods.description: Records metrics related to database open problems.

methods.name: RecordDBMigrationProblem
methods.description: Records metrics related to database migration issues.

methods.name: DoMigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual; embedder-specific method to migrate database schema, returning new version or nullopt on error.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual; creates or verifies database schema, returning success status.

methods.name: DoInitializeDatabase
methods.description: Optional override for additional database initialization tasks.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets and resets the database and metatable.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits pending operations to the database, invoking pre-commit callback.

methods.name: DoCommit
methods.description: Pure virtual; embedder-specific logic to commit pending operations.

methods.name: PostBackgroundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the background task runner.

methods.name: PostClientTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the client task runner.

methods.name: MigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Ensures database schema is up-to-date, performing migration if necessary.

methods.name: FlushAndNotifyInBackground
methods.description: Flushes pending operations on background thread and notifies callback on client thread.

methods.name: DoCloseInBackground
methods.description: Closes the database on background thread.

methods.name: DatabaseErrorCallback
methods.description: Handles database errors, potentially marking corruption and scheduling database kill.

methods.name: KillDatabase
methods.description: Terminates the database in case of catastrophic errors.
